name: seeded-ledger
description: a ledger written elsewhere (DICT/RLE encodings) is read and extended

files.pqledger.conf:
[ledger]
data_dir = ledger
rules_file = rules.conf
budget_file = budgets.conf

[account card]
date_column = Transaction Date
date_format = MM/DD/YYYY
currency_symbol = $
thousands_separator = ,
invert_sign = true

[account giro]
delimiter = ;
skip_lines = 2
date_column = Buchungstag
date_format = DD.MM.YYYY
description_column = Verwendungszweck
amount_mode = debit_credit
debit_column = Soll
credit_column = Haben
decimal_separator = ,
thousands_separator = .
files.rules.conf:
# first match wins
groceries = WHOLE FOODS*, TRADER JOE*, SAFEWAY, REWE*, EDEKA*, LIDL*
coffee = SQ *BLUE BOTTLE*, STARBUCKS*, CAFé*
transport = SHELL*, CHEVRON*, UBER*, LYFT*, ARAL*, DB VERTRIEB*
housing = RENT*, MIETE*
income = PAYROLL*, GEHALT*
shopping = AMAZON*, HOME DEPOT, REI
utilities = PACIFIC GAS*, COMCAST*, STADTWERKE*, TELEKOM*
